prompt_en:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: independent visual-semantics evaluation photograph
Input images: Image 1 is a styling reference only for the visible long dark wavy hairstyle and dark blouse; depict an unmistakably adult original character with her own original facial identity.
Primary request:
Create a photorealistic documentary-style environmental portrait. A specific ordinary workplace and practical task establish everyday reality: inside an after-hours railway lost-property office, An unmistakably adult original woman with her own original facial identity, long dark wavy hair, and a dark blouse quietly sorts a sealed brown-paper parcel at the counter. The office remains convincingly mundane with fluorescent light, metal shelves, ticket stubs, worn linoleum, and a stationary wall clock. One bounded physically impossible occurrence occupies that ordinary setting: Matter-of-fact magical realism occurs as the parcel's ordinary cast shadow opens into a clearly visible moonlit railway platform at full spatial depth; a miniature train crosses it while the parcel stays sealed and solid. The nearby person responds with restrained practical acceptance and calm attention: She calmly records the parcel on a clipboard and slides it toward the shelf without surprise. The same practical routine continues visibly through the impossible occurrence as her logging hand remains poised and the parcel moves toward storage. Coherent contact shadow occlusion and material residue bind the anomaly to ordinary reality: Render the impossible shadow with sharp physical contact to the parcel and consistent floor perspective, with fine black railway soot settling from the shadow onto the worn linoleum. Medium-wide eye-level framing shows the woman, parcel, connected shadow-world, and routine handling together. Natural skin texture, practical mixed fluorescent and amber signal light, and tiny non-semantic ink marks on paperwork.
Reference boundary: take only hairstyle and blouse cues from Image 1; give the adult subject a clearly original facial identity.
Avoid: illustration look, 3D render look, unrealistic hands, excessive HDR, low resolution, cartoon style, over-processed retouching, broken facial features
